title: Trabajo y explotación
goal: Read about three distinct colonial labor systems, and the formal royal debate in Spain over whether indigenous people had full rights as human beings.
grammar: Se pasivo: sistemas de trabajo colonial

items: Explain what the encomienda was and what reform tried to limit its abuses.
Explain how the repartimiento differed from the mita.
Describe what the Valladolid debate was about, and who argued each side.
Explain why enslaved labor from Africa was increasingly used in some regions.
Use the se-passive to describe colonial labor systems and their gradual replacement.
